versions.subject: fix endswith typo
versions.detection:
selection:
    ImagePath|contains|all: 
        - 'new-object'
        - 'text.encoding]::ascii'
    ImagePath|contains:
        - 'system.io.compression.deflatestream'
        - 'system.io.streamreader'
    ImagePath|endswith: 'readtoend'
condition: selection
